George Wein was born in Boston on October 3, 1925. He has made an indelible mark in the jazz world as a pianist, record producer, club owner and founder of the Newport Jazz Festival. George has performed and recorded with a long list of jazz luminaries, including Ruby Braff, Stephane Grappelli and Buck Clayton.
His talent in organizing jazz events is legendary and his formation of Festival Productions will assure that quality festivals will be available to jazz lovers here and abroad for many years to come.
George was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe. We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in New York City. I’m especially pleased that George Wein has found a little time for me today, and I’m most appreciative.
Anybody with the name of Monk can’t be all bad.
